fields.description: Issue includes editor Wen R. Phillips' commentary criticizing Ku Klux Klan activity and election-related intimidation, reproducing purported Klan documents/letters and discussing the 1928 presidential contest (Hoover vs. Al Smith). Articles address governance and funding concerns at Jackson Memorial Hospital and the Deering trust fund administered by the Bank of Bay Biscayne; Prohibition-era liquor smuggling and dangerous moonshine production; and local politics and civic affairs in Miami and Miami Beach. The issue also contains political advertisements (including for Hoover electors and local offices), entertainment and business advertising, and a labor statement regarding a lockout/strike at the Capitol Theatre.
